hints.title: Periodicity
hints.text: The ball moves from child 0 to n - 1 and back to 0, repeating every 2 * (n - 1) seconds.

hints.title: Modulo Operation
hints.text: Calculate the effective remainder r = k % (2 * (n - 1)).

hints.title: Direction Check
hints.text: If r < n, the ball is moving forward and lands at child r. Otherwise, it is moving backward and lands at 2 * (n - 1) - r.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfChild(self, n: int, k: int) -> int:
        cycle = 2 * (n - 1)
        r = k % cycle
        return r if r < n else cycle - r
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating k steps takes O(k) which is redundant when an O(1) cycle formula exists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify the 2 * (n - 1) cycle and compute position directly.
